papers.title: IdeaTaste: Do LLMs Share the Research Taste of Human Researchers?
papers.summary: IdeaTaste benchmarks LLM research proposals against future publications, revealing that AI agents match human communities in broad directions but fall far behind in concrete approaches and expected success.
papers.organization: Carnegie Mellon University School of Computer Science
papers.insight: Novo benchmark ou dataset, um sinal técnico que pode virar produto.

papers.title: Democratizing Robot-Use Agents: A Unified Harness with Open Models
papers.summary: Uni-robot-agent enables open-weight robot-use agents to surpass proprietary models in zero-shot manipulation and suggests joint development of four core capabilities for future training.
papers.insight: Em alta na comunidade, com 38 upvotes no Hugging Face.

papers.title: CUA-Master: Scaling Computer-use Agents through Open-World Recursive Improvements
papers.summary: CUA-Master uses nested recursive loops with open-world data and feedback-driven retries to continuously improve computer-use agents across diverse benchmarks.
papers.insight: Em alta na comunidade, com 90 upvotes no Hugging Face.

papers.title: Measuring AI Agents as Teammates with Collaborative Intelligence
papers.summary: The Collaborative Intelligence Benchmark evaluates AI agents as teammates across 240 tasks, revealing that even top models have significant collaboration weaknesses unrelated to individual capability.
papers.insight: Novo benchmark ou dataset, um sinal técnico que pode virar produto.

papers.title: CoworkOS:Scaling Agent Coworkers for Real-world Automation
papers.summary: CoworkOS is a long-horizon agent harness that separates strategy from execution, supports human-in-the-loop collaboration via shared artifacts, and improves model performance through sustained automated post-training.
papers.insight: Em alta na comunidade, com 85 upvotes no Hugging Face.
